sources.label: WSPN About WUSD disclosure (HQLA policy, indicative 70-80% / 20-30% ranges)

reserveReview.rationale: WSPN's reserve policy limits backing to cash, cash equivalents, and Treasury bills and describes a possible 70-80% cash-equivalent and 20-30% sub-90-day Treasury allocation. Re-verified on 2026-10-01: the About WUSD disclosure and whitepaper publish policy ranges, not dated current composition, and the rendered transparency page commits to independent attestations without a dated reserve-liability report. The old FAQ renders an application 404. The previously reviewed 2024 OpenEden partnership remains historical evidence only: its BusinessWire URL timed out during this session and no current TBILL weight was verified. The single aggregate basket and 100% unknown split are retained without a composition date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: WSPN reserve-management policy; current asset-class weights undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The eligible reserve categories and maximum Treasury maturity are disclosed, but current category weights, instruments, banks, provider shares, and the size of the announced TBILL allocation are not public in the reviewed sources.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi T33 unknown-reduction wave-2 backing review

sources.label: WSPN terms: segregated custodial reserve accounts

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The whitepaper describes a reserve-segregation policy and the terms state that cash and cash equivalents are held in segregated custodial accounts for customers. Neither reviewed document identifies the reserve banks, trustees, custodians, provider shares, actual account structure, bankruptcy treatment, or rehypothecation terms. The former FAQ URL now renders a 404 application error, so its previously recorded licensed-trust-company claim could not be re-verified.
